# Third-party notices

The central test fixture container installs the packages listed below. Versions match `requirements.lock`. Package wheels retain their copyright and license files under the Python `site-packages` distribution metadata directories.

## Python and base image

The pinned `python:3.13.15-slim-trixie` image contains CPython 3.13.15 and Debian GNU/Linux trixie components.

CPython is distributed under the Python Software Foundation License Version 2. Its license and copyright notice are installed in the image at `/usr/local/lib/python3.13/LICENSE.txt`; the license text is also published at `https://docs.python.org/3.13/license.html`.

Debian packages retain their copyright and license notices under `/usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright`. Corresponding source and copyright records are available through `https://sources.debian.org/` and `https://www.debian.org/legal/licenses/`.
